title: 光情報工学
subtitle: Optical Information Engineering
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)learn the basic properties of light (reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, and diffusion).
(2)learn the structures, operating principles and applications about various information devices, systems and display device.
(3)learn the image recognition and quality evaluation technology.
advice:
We will cover the following materials:

1. Basics of wave optics
2. Coherence of light waves
3. Optical waveguide
4. Light wave recording and playback
5. Linear optical system
6. Basics of optical information processing
7. Digital processing of image information
books: "Fundamentals of Optical Information Processing",Takeaki Yoshimura, Corona Publishing Co., LTD.
requiredKnowledge: Review basics of “Electromagnetics”, “Opt-electronic device engineering” and “Introduction to audio and video”.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic characteristics of light waves, the interaction between light and matter.
Be able to describe polarized light wave.
Be able to describe reflection, refraction and coherence of light wave.
Be able to explain light weave transform using an optical system.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the basic properties of light and explain quantitatively using mathematical formulas.
(2) Understand reflection, refraction, interference and propagation of light using mathematical formulas.
(3) Understand light wave transform technology for optical design and be able to analyze image processing operations.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the basic properties of light and explain qualitatively using mathematical formulas.
(2) Understand the concepts of reflection, refraction, interference, propagation of light and explain qualitatively.
(3) Understand the basics of light wave transform for optical design and be able to explain the mechanism of image processing operations.
